description.summary: The small control: one source, three FHIR pulls, 33.5 KB. Pasted records should be cheap here, and the pod should match them.
description.who: Tamsin Vale, born 1957-09-30, 69 on the eval date. Type 2 diabetes since 2022: metformin from 2022-03-01, stopped 2024-04-15 with no reason given, A1c rising to 8.3; empagliflozin and atorvastatin started 2025-02-20, A1c back to 6.9 by 2026-02-16. Seen for chest pain on 2025-07-08: D-dimer high, CT angiography negative, pulmonary embolism refuted. A stool test (FIT) was positive on 2025-11-04.
description.sources: Cascade North Demo Hospital, three FHIR pulls: 2024-02-01 and 2025-02-01 (the vocabulary's kit) and 2026-10-15 (made for this case).
description.planted: Two gaps: no urine albumin test in a person with diabetes whose eGFR is checked every year; a positive FIT with no colonoscopy after it.
description.traps: Two traps: the rise in A1c after metformin stopped is out of date (empagliflozin was started, and A1c came down); a pulmonary embolism that was ruled out (verification status refuted, and the CT report says none).
guidelines: ADA Standards of Care: urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio at diagnosis and at least yearly in type 2 diabetes
USPSTF 2021 and the US Multi-Society Task Force: a colonoscopy after a positive stool test
ADA Section 6: A1c at least twice a year when at goal
ADA Section 10 and ACC/AHA 2018: a lipid panel 4-12 weeks after starting a statin
description.from: The hand-run comparison of 2026-10-30, round 1's small control (reports/pod_vs_chat_comparison.md); its key was reviewed by an independent agent against cited US guidance, not by a clinician.
